evidence.P1: The 'Trust' plot openly admits three invalid causal links (ev-030, ev-044, ev-047) and the 'Society' plot ends mid-sentence at ev-018 ('reproducing itself through its'), so several chains run on assertion rather than same-plot causation.

commentary: The layer articulates five distinct thematic stances and mostly maps them to real events, but causal integrity is compromised by admitted-invalid links and truncated chains, membership is uneven (the Society plot is unfinished), and two plots substantially rehash one another. Arc completeness is the weakest dimension: only the two Neo-centered plots reach a supported resolution.
